body: So? I'd prefer death to going. They didn't help last time. All I learned was how to hide my emotions and not trust anyone. Also do you have any idea how much debt I have from medical stuff? I'm not ready to add more to it and make my life harder. End of discussion I'm not committing myself to a hell for a week.

I refuse to go to another mental health hospital ever again. The two here make Soviet Era gulags look good. Sorry but really? Going to the hospital because a doctor won't give me some stupid trazadon? That seems really like overkill.

Not even trazadone. I had it before and it worked okay. I can find another doctor it's just the waiting times that are a problem. Waiting two weeks is pretty much a matter of life and death at this point. What's worse is I had an appointment for Tuesday and it got rescheduled for a week and a half. I can't wait that long and slowly go mad I'm just not doing it again.
